title: heterotheca oligantha
intro: Heterotheca oligantha, commonly known as Poverty Weed, is a flowering plant species within the family Asteraceae. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, with health benefits including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, which may help to soothe and protect the body from damage. The therapeutic actions of Heterotheca oligantha are thought to be attributed to its ability to reduce inflammation and promote wound healing, making it a potential natural remedy for various health issues. Bioactive constituents found in the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
